tagline: Twin-orbiter joint ESA + JAXA Mercury mission — splits into MPO + Mio at Mercury arrival in 2026
description: Joint ESA + JAXA mission. Launched 2018-10-20 on an Ariane 5 ECA. Mercury Transfer Module carries the stack on a 7-year flyby cruise (1 Earth + 2 Venus + 6 Mercury gravity assists) before Mercury orbit insertion on 2026-11-21. At arrival the two science orbiters separate: ESA's Mercury Planetary Orbiter (MPO) flies a 480 × 1500 km polar orbit with 11 instruments for surface composition, topography, gravity, and exosphere; JAXA's Mio (Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter) flies a 590 × 11 640 km polar orbit with 5 instruments for the magnetosphere and plasma. Together they are the first European + Japanese spacecraft ever in Mercury orbit.
best_known_for: Joint ESA + JAXA twin-orbiter Mercury mission — MPO + Mio at Mercury, 2026 arrival
